gaps.sentence: The plane will drop ___ the parcels at the next farm.
gaps.explanation: drop off = deliver somebody/something; also become less (sales dropped off).

gaps.sentence: Hurry ___ or we'll miss the ferry!
If you don't know the word, look it ___ in a dictionary.
gaps.explanation: look a word up = find it in a dictionary/reference.

gaps.sentence: You can count ___ me if you need help.
gaps.explanation: count on somebody = rely on them.

gaps.sentence: She ___ down an offer from a rival university.
Sales figures have tailed ___ since the summer.
They want to try ___ the new software before buying.
gaps.explanation: try out = test something to see if it works.

gaps.sentence: The new law will phase ___ disposable plastics by 2030.
gaps.explanation: phase out = gradually stop using something.
